capabilityHints.summary: A creator launches a WETH-paired token whose liquidity is always-for-sale: LPs self-price their share claims, pay a continuous tax rebated to all LPs, and anyone can buy out a claim at the self-price; tax-exhausted claims are liquidated by redistributing shares to remaining LPs.

components.summary: The one immutable hook bound to the canonical dynamic-fee PoolKey. It binds exactly one pool once at afterInitialize, precommitting the exact launch token, start price and tick spacing so a front-runner cannot capture it with a foreign pool. It custodies one full-range position and mints self-priced share claims, draws a continuous Harberger tax from each claim's pre-paid deposit and rebates it to all LPs, lets anyone but the owner buy a claim out at its self-price, recycles a tax-exhausted claim to the remaining LPs, and collects the mandatory Programmable volume fee on the executed gross quote-side amount across all four swap quadrants as owner-claimable ERC-6909 quote claims held separately from the tax reserve.

Single-use launcher. One transaction deploys the token, deploys the hook at the mined address, initialises the canonical dynamic-fee pool and seeds the initial full-range position through the hook's own custody deposit; the resulting Harberger claim is owned by the launcher, which exposes no withdraw, buyout, transfer, rescue, arbitrary-call, owner or upgrade path. Any mismatch reverts the whole transaction.
Fixed-supply ERC-20 minted once in its constructor to the launcher. No owner, minter, pauser, blacklist, transfer tax, rebase, upgrade path or rescue function exists.

project.summary: An always-for-sale AMM hook: LPs self-price their custodied liquidity, pre-pay a continuous Harberger tax rebated to active LPs, and anyone can buy them out at that price; unfunded liquidity is recycled.
project.title: Harberger AMM
